passive.name: Searing Brilliance
passive.description: Whenever Mel uses an ability, she gains three bonus projectiles (up to nine maximum) on her next attack. When Mel deals damage through an ability or attack, she applies Overwhelm, which can stack infinitely. If the enemy is hit by Mel with enough Overwhelm damage, the stacks are consumed to execute the target.

spells.name: Radiant Volley
spells.description: Mel unleashes a barrage of projectiles that explode in the area around a target location. The first explosion hit deals magic damage and each subsequent explosion deals magic damage, adding up to magic damage total.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation InitialExplosionDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Rebuttal
spells.description: Mel forms a barrier around herself that reflects projectiles from enemy champions, gaining Shields for seconds and % decaying Move Speed for seconds. Reflected projectiles deal original damage as magic damage.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation DamagePercent was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Solar Snare
spells.description: Mel fires a radiating orb, Rooting enemies at its center for seconds and dealing magic damage. The orb builds up a hostile area around it that Slows enemies by % and deals magic damage per second.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation Damage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.

spells.name: Golden Eclipse
spells.description: Passive: Overwhelm damage is increased to magic damage plus magic damage per stack. Active: Mel unleashes her power on all enemies affected by Overwhelm, dealing magic damage plus magic damage per Overwhelm stack. Can only be cast when an enemy champion is affected by Overwhelm.
spells.coverageNote: CommunityDragon calculation PassiveFlatDamage was normalized. Complex subcasts remain selectable assumptions.
